summary.text: Chris Banning is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 24 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey during his 2022 campaign, Chris Banning described himself as a husband, father, businessman and veteran who served in Desert Storm and Desert Shield and is acting CEO of Banning Investment Group.
He also said he volunteered in the rescue and recovery effort after the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing.

Banning assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Logan Phillips; for 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee, and in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Business and Commerce Committee.
In the 2022 survey, he said he is passionate about education and protecting children, supporting veterans, economic and small business growth, government contracting and infrastructure.
